description: Senior Sendoff! Hey everyone! Join us this Friday, 5/1 from 8-10pm in SERC 208 for our final meeting of the year! We'll be celebrating our graduating seniors and eboard members with grad cap decorating and some board games! Feel free to bring your grad cap as decorations will be provided, and for those not graduating we will have picture frames available for decorating as well! title: Late Knight with Caleb Hearon
description: Get ready for a night of laughs and unfiltered conversation at Late Knight! Join us for a moderated Q&A with comedian and writer Caleb Hearon, known for his sharp wit, viral sketches, and unapologetically honest takes on life, pop culture, and everything in between. Caleb has built a massive following through his hilarious social media presence and podcast appearances, bringing a unique blend of storytelling, sarcasm, and chaos that keeps audiences hooked. Whether you’ve seen his viral videos or are just looking for a fun Friday night, this is your chance to hear directly from one of comedy’s rising voices. 🎤 Event Details Who: @calebsaysthings Where: College Avenue Student Center - MPR When: Doors Open @ 9:00 PM | Show Starts @ 9:30 PM Co-sponsored with @RUPArutgers 🎟 Important Info Open to Rutgers–New Brunswick students only RSVP required on getINVOLVED — seats are limited!

title: RULing 2026
description: The Linguistics Graduate Student Association invites you to the 21st annual RULing conference, our end-of-the year departmental conference/workshop. Graduate students from our department will be presenting their work. This year's edition of RULing will host a special panel on industry jobs from three alumni: Vandana Bajaj, Ang Li, and Nate Koser. Lunch will be provided at the mid-day break! All graduate students are welcome to attend the event. This event is funded by the Graduate Student Association (GSA).

title: AXON 7.0
description: Nu Rho Psi is hosting AXON 7.0, our annual neuroscience research conference! We welcome presenters from all over the Northeast to talk about their neuroscience research. Join our Symposium for the opportunity to learn about research and connect with researchers from all over the Northeast. If you would like to present your research, you also have the chance to win an award! We are open to all disciplines (psych, cog sci, etc) as long as it falls under the neuroscience umbrella! We also have virtual options to present! The conference will be held on May 2nd in Psych 105 (times may be subject to change based on the itinerary For more information visit our website, where you can register for the conference and submit your abstract: https://axon2026.myportfolio.com/

title: Writing a Life
description: Join Dr. Roxane Gay for a full day conference about memoir. Learn how authors write about how their lived experiences have shaped them and how they move through the world. The day will feature a keynote, workshops, and an editors and agents panel. Books by all speakers will be available for purchase. Register at go.rutgers.edu/1ew1a9ia

title: Hey all!
description:
Hey all! 
As a reminder: As mentioned in our last meeting, we are now meeting biweekly, starting this most recent week. 
We'll be posting updates each week here and on Instagram to keep you guys updated. On the off-cycles, we'll be using the room to either study, meet up for a bit before getting food, or just relax. 

Our officers & interns will always be present, both on meetings and off-cycle hangouts - but this is an open invite to any and all general members that would like to join us - and we'd totally love to see you there! This upcoming Monday (11/10) is our first off-cycle week, where we'll be using the room to study and relax for a bit before potentially going on a food run later in the evening.
